mechanism: Copy a causal ADD aligned with the observed five-level Hyperliquid book, sizing each paper position from 5 or 10 percent of the smaller visible bid/ask capacity at signal time, floored at 75 USD and capped at 600 USD.
temporal_operator: At each TRAIN ADD, read the first causal five-level book no later than the fixed reference lag, compute two-sided executable capacity without future data, enter after the canonical delay, and exit after one hour. Daily admission counters use only earlier entries.
conditioning: signed five-level depth imbalance minimum 0, 0.20, or 0.50
size 5 or 10 percent of entry-observable two-sided depth
minimum paper notional 75 USD and maximum 600 USD
maximum one admitted entry per vault per UTC day
maximum one admitted entry per coin per UTC day
canonical taker costs and exact observed five-level VWAP
direction-flip placebo uses the same causal size and admitted identity
only complete actual and placebo episodes enter aggregation
execution_translation: Paper-only taker entry and exit using a size fixed from the signal-time book before any outcome is known. Spread, slippage, adverse latency, and canonical fees are reconciled. No order, collection, future feature, or invented liquidity is allowed.
prediction_target: At least 4 USD net per TRAIN day with eight trades across three days, profit factor above one, direction placebo beaten, positive 424-trial-adjusted total lower bound, top positive trade share and largest vault and coin shares at most 60 percent, and complete counted episodes.
falsification_test: Reject if none of the six fixed depth-threshold and capacity-fraction variants passes every TRAIN gate. Heldout and forward remain unopened before freeze.
notes: TRAIN-only replay rejected without opening heldout. The best depth-sized variant passed the 8-trade, four-day, profitability, placebo, concentration, liquidatability, cost-reconciliation, and 4 USD/day gates at 21.61 USD net and 5.40 USD/day, but failed the 424-trial-adjusted lower-bound gate because gains were concentrated in the final TRAIN day.
rationale: V17 passed economics, costs, placebo, liquidatability, and concentration but produced only six 600 USD trades. Causal depth sizing admits smaller executable positions from additional vaults while bounding exposure and preserving the profitable aligned ADD mechanism.
